info.description: This course is designed to review and build upon students’ grammatical command of English structures in order to enhance their written and spoken performances in academic settings. The course seeks to achieve this goal in a manner that differs from typical foundational grammar courses, in that this course does not examine grammatical features in isolation from one another (e.g., spending a week on the past tense without looking at other tenses); instead, this class examines grammar points as smaller systems lodged within a larger system (e.g., examining all verb tenses together to understand how they function as a group). Students will practice covered structures, and will produce several original works that will grammatically evolve over the course of the quarter (as more and more material is covered).
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

Folse, K. S., Solomon, E. V., & Smith-Palinkas, B.

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate deep understanding and fluent use of different tenses in English and tense-related points
Describe clearly the use of nouns, pronouns, adjectives, adverbs, conjunctions, noun clauses, adjective clauses, adverbial clauses, conditional sentences and different types of sentences in English
Distinguish and fluently use common and complicated grammatical structures of English in oral and written academic presentations
Recognise how different English grammar points in the system relate to one another
Value other people's writing or speech
Demonstrate the ability to write or rewrite ideas based on a deep understanding of the intrinsic traits of language
Construct correct grammartical structures in practical activities required in all other subjects of writing and speaking activities in the classroom.
